howItWorks.title: Getting Started Takes 2 Minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: Seriously. You'll be watching in no time.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Rate 5-10 shows. Love it? Like it? Hate it? That's all we need. Takes less time than making coffee.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Solo? Get instant picks tailored to you. With friends? Create a watch room and we'll find shows that make everyone happy.
howItWorks.step3Desc: No more scrolling paralysis. Every recommendation comes with a reason why we think you'll love it. Just pick and watch.

features.title: Why People Are Switching to ShowSync
features.subtitle: Because life's too short for bad recommendations
features.smartDesc: Forget generic 'trending now' lists. We learn what YOU love - your guilty pleasures, your hidden favorites, your weird obsessions. Then we find more of that.
features.customPrefsDesc: Want something cozy? Dark? Funny but not too silly? Just tell us your mood and we'll adjust. It's like having a friend who always knows what you'd like.
features.groupsDesc: Building your personal watchlist? We've got you. Planning movie night with friends? Create a room and we'll find shows everyone will actually enjoy.
features.timeDesc: Stop spending 30 minutes deciding what to watch. Get matched with your next favorite show in seconds, not hours.
features.noCompromiseTitle: Don't Like Our Picks? Try Again
features.noCompromiseDesc: Not feeling the recommendations? Tweak your preferences and regenerate. No commitment, no settling, no compromises.

cta.title: Stop Wasting Your Evenings on the Wrong Shows
cta.description: Join thousands who've already ditched the endless scrolling and started watching shows they actually finish.

problemStatement.title: Sound Familiar?
problemStatement.subtitle: You're not alone. Most of us waste more time choosing than actually watching.
problemStatement.soloDesc: You open Netflix with excitement. 20 minutes later, you're still scrolling, feeling overwhelmed.
problemStatement.groups: With friends? Prepare for the debate
problemStatement.groupsDesc: 'What should we watch?' becomes a 30-minute negotiation where nobody's happy with the final choice.
problemStatement.everyoneDesc: 400+ titles browsed per session. Result? You give up and rewatch The Office. Again.

faq.title: Questions You Might Have
faq.q1: Can I use this alone or do I need a group?
faq.a1: Both! Use it solo for your personal watchlist, or create watch rooms with friends. It's built for however you watch.
faq.q2: What makes this better than Netflix's recommendations?
faq.a2: Netflix pushes trending shows and originals. We focus on YOUR taste - including the weird stuff, the old stuff, the hidden gems. Plus, group recommendations that actually work? Netflix can't do that.
faq.q3: How do you know what I'll like?
faq.a3: Magic! Just kidding - you rate shows you've seen (love it, like it, or meh). We analyze patterns in your taste and find shows that match. The more you rate, the better we get.
faq.q4: What's the catch? Where's the premium upsell?
faq.a4: No catch. 100% free forever. No credit card, no hidden fees, no 'premium features'. We're building something cool and want everyone to use it.
faq.a5: 2 minutes. Really. Sign up, rate 5 shows, done. You can rate more later for better results, but 5 is enough to start getting great recommendations.
